persona_model_map_note: Agents in agents/ and .opencode/agents/ take their model: frontmatter from roles[persona_model_map[persona]] via tools/sync_agent_models.py. The hacker persona line carries the hacker-max default; dispatch selects the actual variant from roles[hacker-<variant>] (hacker-high or hacker-max) per policies/tiers.json.

orchestrator.reason: orchestrator==builder (opencode-go deepseek-v4.1-flash#max) by design: orchestrator routes, builder implements; no independence claim between them. Independence claim applies only to author<->auditor<->hacker triangle.

release-engineer.reason: auditor/release-engineer share the glm-5.3-flash family (auditor: nous, no variant; release-engineer: opencode-go#high) by design (verifier/deployer cost grouping); independence claim applies only to author<->auditor<->hacker triangle; release-engineer vs auditor is intentionally allowed, hacker edges are enforced (families differ).

independence_scope.author_group_note: builder, compliance, and crouton-alpha are the author roles; authors are an intentional same-family group, so no independence claim is made among authors (builder and crouton-alpha are both deepseek). Each author role must still differ in family from auditor, hacker-high, and hacker-max.
independence_scope.independence_claim: Enforced claim is author->verifier/hacker: each author role (builder, compliance, crouton-alpha) family != auditor, hacker-high, hacker-max; auditor != hacker-high, hacker-max; hacker-high != hacker-max (mutual, families minimax vs openai, enforced because cost allows).

intentional_cost_groupings.reason: orchestrator routes, builder implements; same model saves cost, no independence claim

intentional_cost_groupings.model: glm-5.3-flash (auditor: nous, no variant; release-engineer: opencode-go#high)
intentional_cost_groupings.reason: verifier/deployer share cheap glm flash tier; independence claim applies only to author<->auditor<->hacker triangle

independence_scope.note: orchestrator/builder same-model is intentional cost grouping (chosen over hard forbid); hacker-high vs hacker-max mutual forbid is enforced (chosen over document-allowed because families already differ, no extra cost).

enforcement.exempt_policy: skip edges listed in independence[role].exempt_edges; skip whole role when independence[role].enforced is false; enforced edges must be family-distinct

acceptance_author_role_note: Legacy singular 'hacker' is a deprecated alias for 'hacker-high' (backward compat). New capabilities must use a canonical enum value. 'human' means hand-authored outside the factory (family sentinel 'human'). Otherwise family is models.roles[canonical_role].family.
acceptance_author_family_note: capability.acceptance_author_family is derived as models.roles[canonical acceptance_author_role].family (human -> 'human'), never free text. If a capability records a non-default author (e.g. hand-authored deepseek), capability.acceptance_author_policy must name that canonical role and family must equal that role's family; auditor re-derives when family == builder family (deepseek). Default derived family for hacker-high is 'minimax'.

provider_notes.auditor/release-engineer: auditor is nous glm-5.3-flash while release-engineer is opencode-go glm-5.3-flash#high, family glm, intentional cost grouping; independence claim applies only to author<->auditor<->hacker triangle
provider_notes.hacker-high: nous portal minimax-m3.1-flash, no variant (the nous alias exposes no variants; #high is not resolvable); hacker-high != hacker-max mutual forbid is enforced (minimax vs openai, cost allows)
provider_notes.hacker-max: openai gpt-6-luna directly (variant max); hacker-max != hacker-high mutual forbid is enforced
provider_notes.orchestrator/builder: opencode-go deepseek (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#max); orchestrator==builder is an intentional cost grouping (chosen over hard forbid), independence claim applies only to author<->auditor<->hacker triangle
provider_notes.acceptance: default author hacker-high (minimax, derived family minimax); legacy 'hacker' aliases to hacker-high, deprecated; capability family is derived from roles, never free text
provider_notes.fallback: opencode-go is the fallback provider (minimax-m3.1-flash, glm-5.3-flash, mimo-v2.6-pro)
provider_notes.not_used: nous x402 proxy (127.0.0.1:8890) and bedrock luna were unavailable; not used
provider_notes.variant_resolution: nous provider models expose no variants; auditor/hacker-high/compliance selectors omit #variant. opencode-go and openai models keep their declared variants.
